description_en: Queries the authorization progress based on the unique ID (CheckProgressId) returned by the batch device authorization operation
description_zh: 调用该接口根据批量授权设备接口返回的唯一ID（CheckProgressId）查询授权的进度
name: CheckBindLicenseDeviceProgress

parameters.help_en:
Enterprise instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
For new public instances or Enterprise Edition instances, Enterprise instance has an ID value. You must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
For legacy public instances, Enterprise instance has no ID value. You do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
对于新版公共实例或企业版实例，实例有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
对于旧版公共实例，实例无ID值，无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The license type (audio and video specification). Valid values: 480P and 720P
parameters.help_zh: License类型（音视频规格），可取值：480P、720P
parameters.name: license_code

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.

You can view the information of all products in the current instance in the IoT Platform console or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
设备所属产品的ProductKey。

您可以在物联网平台控制台或调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html，查看当前实例下所有产品的信息
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en: The unique ID for querying the progress of batch device authorization
parameters.help_zh: 查询批量授权设备进度的唯一ID
parameters.name: check_progress_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see Error codes in this topic
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见本文下方错误码

FailSum.description_en: The number of devices for which license authorization failed

Progress.description_en: The progress percentage of license authorization for batch devices. Valid values: 1 to 100
Progress.description_zh: 为批量设备授权License的进度百分比，即取值范围为1~100

ResultCsvFile.description_en: The URL of the result file after the authorization is complete. This is the storage address of the file in Object Storage Service (OSS)
ResultCsvFile.description_zh: 授权完成后的结果文件的URL。即文件在对象存储（OSS）上的存储地址

SuccessSum.description_en: The number of devices for which licenses were successfully authorized

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
